liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Bird Song** (1 review): Reviewer names it as one of the few moments where Garcia shone [7]
- **Black Peter** (1 review): Reviewer names it, along with Bird Song, as a standout in an otherwise weak night [7]
- **Throwin' Stones** (1 review): Reviewer dislikes the show closing with this song and finds the playing uninspired [13]

## Setlist highlights

- **Sonic Space**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [19]
- **Midi Space**: back after 310 archived shows (1590 days); mythic rare: 2 archived performances [19]

## The recordings

- **gd1994-03-04.sbd.sailor_saint.33697.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 18 songs; 144 min; rated 2.56/5 by 9 [1]. Said about its sound: No fades or time alterations; the music runs in real time, with track markers added between songs [1]
- **gd94-03-04.sbd.kidder.8330.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 17 songs; 145 min; rated 2.79/5 by 14 [3]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says the soundboard sounds excellent, with a fantastic mix that rewards listening at high volume [8]
- **gd1994-03-04.152011.sbd.latvala.flac16**: soundboard; 17 songs; 147 min [4]. Said about its sound: Left channel has occasional dropouts with muffled right audio, mostly noticeable at the starts of songs [4]
- **gd1994-03-04.schoepsMK4.litzenberger.89172.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 18 songs; 149 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]

## Around the show

- Reviewer relays that at least one night was free, and the crowd flattened a chain-link fence, reportedly leading to a brick wall [10]
- Reviewer says the brick wall already existed, and many people got in free on the Saturday night [12]
- Around the start of Stagger Lee, a crowd of heads came pouring over the wall behind the lawn [12]
- Reviewer recalls a man crawling under the fence, unchallenged by the guard, then climbing the brick wall to get in [14]
- Reviewer condemns the fence-breaking stampede, noting the band had urged ticketless fans to stay home [15]
- Reviewer's dog and its dad got into the show and ran up the lawn hill near the Phil Zone [16]
- Venue was billed with Blockbuster in its name, as Blockbuster Desert Sky Pavilion [17]
- Venue was billed with Blockbuster in its name, as Blockbuster Desert Sky Pavilion [18]
- Reviewer remembers this as one of Garcia's off nights, with only a few highlights [7]
- Reviewer thinks it holds up against other shows but may not be the best of the 1990s [8]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1994-03-04.sbd.sailor_saint.33697.flac16**: transferred by C. Allen; source: SBD> ?> CDR> EAC> FLAC [1]. Also: Uploader got copies from the radio host; shares its genealogy with the 3/5/94 recording they posted [1]
- **gd94-03-04.sbd.kidder.8330.sbeok.shnf**: source: DSBD --> DAT --> CDR [3]. Also: Taper chain is soundboard to DAT to CDR, via Charlie Kidder [3]
- **gd1994-03-04.152011.sbd.latvala.flac16**: taped by DATs provided to KXCI's Dead Air program by Dick Latvala for broadcast in April of 1999.; transferred by Fresh transfer and mastering by Jim Blackwood Sony R-500 to Tascam DA-3000 [2020] Track FLAC and Pack by Mark Goldey; source: SBD > DAT 44.1 kHz [4]
- **gd1994-03-04.schoepsMK4.litzenberger.89172.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Keith Litzenberger; transferred by Keith Litzenberger; source: Schoeps MK4's>Rbox>Sony TCD-D10PROII FOB [2]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Mason's Children: [March Grateful Dead Show Listening Guides](https://www.gratefuldeadbook.com/post/march-grateful-dead-show-listening-guides) [20]
- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Desert Sky Pavilion - March 4, 1994](https://www.dead.net/show/march-4-1994) [21]
- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1994-03-04 Grateful Dead Backstage Pass - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/1994-03-04-grateful-dead-backstage-pass/) [22]
